# Camp Resource: Spoiled Apple Tree

It looks like you waited too long to pick this fruit.

Generates Spoiled Fruit.

This item cannot be built inside of a Shelter.

- C.A.M.P. ITEMS APPEAR WHILE IN C.A.M.P. MODE. -

__Spoiled Apple Tree__

**Produces**

Spoiled Fruit

**Build limit per camp**

1 per camp

**Build limit per workshop**

1 per workshop

**Shares a build limit with**

None

**Found under X in the camp build menu**

Resources

**Holds**

1 Pound

**Obtainable via**

Atom Shop - __Spoiled Apple Tree__ - 700 Atoms

**Produces X amount per**

Every 10 Minutes and 12 Seconds

**Lockable**

Yes

**Power Required**

No

**Flamingo Units**

1 Flaming Unit
